# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Context
- This is a GitHub profile repository (`karaage53177a/karaage53177a`)
- The primary purpose of this repository is to manage the GitHub profile README

## Rules and Conventions
- Profile content (README.md) must be written in English
- Commit messages must be written in Japanese
- Use Semantic Commit Messages (e.g., `✨ feat:`, `🐛 fix:`, `📝 docs:`)

## Scope Limitations
- Do not add unnecessary files or automation
- Focus mainly on README.md
- Avoid excessive changes or embellishment
- Prioritize clarity and readability over cleverness or buzzwords

## Notes
- This repository does not contain application code
- The README is intended for human readers, not for showcasing technical complexity
